name: std-dashboard-grid-embedded
description: std-dashboard-grid-embedded — embeddable sibling of std-dashboard-grid-layout. Renders the same toolbar / filter / 12-tile grid contract WITHOUT wrapping it in dashboard-layout chrome (no sidebar, no appName, no nav). Use inside another app shell that already owns the surrounding chrome.

filter1Trait.description: Trait reference for the first filter-row position. Format '@trait.<TraitName>' picks any trait declared on the orbital (typical use: date range picker); '@trait.EmptyTile' leaves the slot blank. Override THIS config to add, swap, remove, or reorder filter controls — never edit other traits.
filter1Trait.label: Filter slot 1

minTileWidth.description: Minimum CSS width per tile before the grid re-flows (a CSS length, e.g. "320px" or "20rem")
minTileWidth.label: Tile min width

theme.description: Design-system skin applied to the embedded grid surface via data-theme (e.g. 'linear-clean-light'). Empty inherits the surrounding shell's theme. Needed because this atom renders without app-shell chrome, so no layout-level theme cascade reaches it.
theme.label: Theme
